title: Apple's First Folding iPhone: 3 Things to Know
description:
Apple's first folding iPhone, the iPhone Duo, went on sale on October 23 starting at $1,999.
Here are 3 things to know: two screens (5.4" outside, 7.6" inside), 5.2 mm thin when open but 254 g heavy, and Touch ID in the side button instead of Face ID. New orders already slip to late January 2027.
